categories.main_business_segments: Beijing E-Hualu Information Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: (1) Digital Systems and Infrastructure, including smart city solutions, intelligent transportation systems, and data lake infrastructure; and (2) Data Operations and Services, encompassing data asset evaluation, public data authorization operations, data element market construction, and digital talent training. The company also provides enterprise digital transformation consulting and data asset management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include optical-magnetic-electric integrated super-intelligent storage systems utilizing blue-ray optical storage technology, big data governance and treatment platforms (Yi-Zhi product line), privacy computing platforms, blockchain-based data security monitoring systems, and AI-powered video perception and analysis technologies. Manufacturing methods involve both software development and hardware integration, with significant in-house R&D capabilities for storage systems and data management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include provincial and municipal governments, state-owned enterprises, central enterprises, and industry-leading companies. Key end markets are smart city construction, intelligent transportation systems, public data operations, enterprise digital transformation, and data element market development. The company serves customers across multiple sectors including transportation, healthcare, finance, education, and public administration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with 25 operational data lakes distributed across 20 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. Key regions include the Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Greater Bay Area, Northeast China, Southwest China, and Northwest China. The company also has limited international operations through its subsidiary Infologic Pte Ltd in Singapore and projects in countries along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in data infrastructure and storage technology development; midstream in data governance, processing, and asset management services; and downstream in data application services and smart city solutions. The company provides end-to-end data element services from collection and storage through processing, evaluation, and commercialization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing data asset capitalization and data element market development; (2) developing optical-magnetic-electric hybrid storage systems and blue-ray storage technology; (3) building AI training resource libraries and large language models for industry applications; (4) expanding smart transportation and smart city solutions; and (5) promoting digital talent cultivation. R&D focuses on data governance platforms, privacy computing, blockchain applications, and AI-powered analytics.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) solution contracts for smart city and intelligent transportation projects; (2) product sales of storage systems and software; (3) service and consulting fees for data asset evaluation, data element market construction, and enterprise digital transformation; (4) data operations and licensing fees from public data authorization; and (5) training and talent development programs. Revenue is recognized upon project completion, service delivery, or performance of contractual obligations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading data element service provider and smart city solution vendor in China. Key competitors include other smart city and big data platform providers, though the company emphasizes its unique advantages in data asset capitalization, optical storage technology, and comprehensive data element lifecycle services. The company is recognized as a strategic-level data merchant by major data exchanges and holds leadership positions in data asset evaluation and public data operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total assets of 13.31 billion yuan and total equity of 4.11 billion yuan. 2023 revenue was 765 million yuan (down 52.31% from 1.60 billion yuan in 2022), with a net loss of 1.89 billion yuan attributable to significant asset impairment provisions. The company experienced substantial losses in 2023 due to business transition, project settlement adjustments, and increased impairment provisions, though the company maintains substantial asset base and strategic positioning.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation centers on: (1) proprietary optical-magnetic-electric integrated storage technology offering long-term, low-cost, secure data preservation; (2) comprehensive data asset capitalization services including evaluation, accounting treatment, and management platforms; (3) pioneering work in public data authorization operations and data element market construction; (4) integrated solutions spanning data infrastructure, governance, and application; and (5) strategic positioning as a central enterprise subsidiary supporting national data security and digital economy development. The company emphasizes green, secure, and controllable data infrastructure aligned with national strategic objectives.
